dataset_info.source: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA OpenSTAT DB/2E/CS), DOST-PAGASA CliMap v2.1 (1991-2020), & NASA POWER Agroclimatology MERRA-2 (Year-Matched 1987-2025)
non_ml_informational_inputs: soil_type (agronomic reference only, not used by ML model)

leakage_audit.cross_validation_protocol: 5-Fold CV inside 2010-2021 Train Split + 5-Fold Province GroupKFold Diagnostic
leakage_audit.model_selection_criterion: Highest 5-Fold Validation CV R² inside training split (no test-set peeking)

best_model.name: Random Forest Regressor
best_model.r2_definition: Coefficient of Determination (proportion of variance explained across Philippine crops & provinces), not literal accuracy %.
best_model.explanation: Random Forest Regressor was automatically selected via 5-Fold Cross-Validation inside the 2010–2021 training panel (CV R² = 0.9246 ± 0.0075, CV RMSE = 25,954 hg/ha), without peeking at the holdout test set. On unseen 2022–2025 Philippine provincial harvests (8,249 records), it achieved Test R² = 0.7332 (Seen Crops R² = 0.7369), MAE = 20,447.81 hg/ha (2.04 MT/ha), and RMSE = 50,030.50 hg/ha, outperforming the Linear Regression baseline by +33.74 R² percentage points and reducing MAE by 50.9%. Primary drivers: Crop Type (item) (49.5%) and Philippine Province (area) (40.8%). Note: R² measures proportion of variance explained (Coefficient of Determination), not a literal percentage accuracy guarantee; 28 well-sampled crops use this ML model directly while 7 sparse/low-predictability crops fall back to verified PSA provincial historical statistics.
